A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''Imperial officer''' served on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] around [[18 BBY]]. As an [[Imperial officer|officer]], he commanded a [[Unidentified clone trooper regiment|regiment]] of [[clone trooper]]s, and called for them to a halt when protesters pelted rocks at the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] as they marched through a town on Ferrix. In retaliation, he ordered the last rank of [[trooper]]s to turn and take aim on the civilians, including [[Clem Andor]]. Andor was [[Hanging|hanged]] soon after, despite being innocent.

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], an [[Imperial officer]] commanded<ref name="Announcement" /> a [[Unidentified clone trooper regiment|regiment]]<ref name="Announcement AD" /> of [[clone trooper]]s on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] in the [[Free Trade sector]] of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Announcement" />

Sometime in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> several Ferrix residents [[Rix Road Protest|protested]] the [[Cloning|clone]]<ref name="Announcement" /> [[regiment]]'s<ref name="Announcement AD" /> presence in the [[Gavalox Communications|business center's]] [[Rix Road]] by signaling their support for the [[Galactic Republic]] and a "free Ferrix." However, when some of the protestors began pelting the [[troop]]s with [[stone]]s, the Imperial [[officer]] ordered the clones to halt and hold the town's residents at gunpoint, including [[Clem Andor]] who did not participate in the protest. Nevertheless, Andor was [[Death|executed]] by [[hanging]] in the town square.<ref name="Announcement" />

==Personality and traits==
The Imperial officer was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with light skin, [[Color|dark-brown]] [[hair]], and a neatly trimmed moustache. He did not tolerate dissent, and was fully willing to have his troops hold civilians at gunpoint.<ref name="Announcement" />

==Equipment==
The officer wore a black [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] with black waterproof cape.<ref name="Announcement" /> He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] with four blue squares.<ref name="BlackSeries" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in "[[Announcement]]", the seventh episode of the live action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', where they were portrayed by [[Jolyon Coy]].<ref name="Announcement" />
